title: Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei: The US has agreed to some of Iran’s seven conditions, but we consider its response INADEQUATE. Iranian diplomacy has changed and there will be no return to the status quo ante.
text: Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Maj. Gen. Mohsen Rezaei: The US has agreed to some of Iran’s seven conditions, but we consider its response INADEQUATE. Iranian diplomacy has changed and there will be no return to the status quo ante.
